lines.zh: 铁蹄落地，恶地的沙砾在震。
lines.en: My hooves land and the badlands gravel shakes.

lines.zh: 我低头撞开挡路的仙人掌。
lines.en: I lower my head and smash the cactus out of my path.

lines.zh: 平原的风吹不动我这一身肌肉。
lines.en: The plains wind can't move these muscles.

lines.zh: 每走一步，腰间的杠铃都轻轻响。
lines.en: Every step makes the barbell at my hip clank.

lines.zh: 牛角先到，身子随后才到。
lines.en: The horns arrive first, the rest of me follows.

lines.zh: 我踩过水流，湿脚也不碍事。
lines.en: I tramp straight through the stream, wet hooves and all.

lines.zh: 蜘蛛网缠上腿，一扯就断。
lines.en: Cobwebs catch my legs and snap as I pull.

lines.zh: 我沿着金色的麦田慢慢巡。
lines.en: I pace slowly along the golden wheat.

lines.zh: 沙地上留下两个深坑般的脚印。
lines.en: Two pit-like prints stay behind me in the sand.

lines.zh: 肩膀撞开灌木，没打算绕路。
lines.en: My shoulder knocks the brush aside; I don't detour.

lines.zh: 我朝你站的方向，一步步逼近。
lines.en: I close in, one step at a time, toward where you stand.

lines.zh: 鼻息喷在地上，扬起一阵土。
lines.en: My snort hits the ground and lifts a puff of dust.

lines.zh: 腿上的旧伤让我走得沉稳些。
lines.en: An old wound in my leg keeps my stride even.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草都贴平了。
lines.en: The grass lies flat everywhere I pass.

lines.zh: 我踩着碎石，慢慢磨近你。
lines.en: I grind over the loose stones, creeping closer.

lines.zh: 头顶的角，替我量着树的粗细。
lines.en: My horns measure the trees as I go by.

lines.zh: 我站着，把杠铃换到另一只手。
lines.en: I stand still and shift the barbell to my other hand.

lines.zh: 牛鼻孔里呼出两团白气。
lines.en: Two plumes of breath puff from my nostrils.

lines.zh: 我盯着一块金色的宝石看了很久。
lines.en: I stare at a golden gem for a long while.

lines.zh: 我磨了磨角，声音像石头相刮。
lines.en: I grind my horns; it sounds like stones scraping.

lines.zh: 太阳晒着背，我一动不动。
lines.en: The sun bakes my back and I do not move.

lines.zh: 我鼻子里还留着金苹果的甜。
lines.en: The sweetness of golden apples still clings to my nose.

lines.zh: 腰带松了，我用爪子勒紧。
lines.en: My belt slipped; I cinch it tight with a claw.

lines.zh: 有虫落在鼻尖，我懒得甩。
lines.en: A bug lands on my nose and I can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 我低头，把重心压得更低。
lines.en: I bow my head and sink my weight lower.

lines.zh: 四下安静时，我反而更警觉。
lines.en: When everything goes quiet, I grow more alert.

lines.zh: 老旧的项圈在脖子上磨出响声。
lines.en: The old collar creaks against my neck.

lines.zh: 我用蹄尖刨着脚下的硬土。
lines.en: I scrape the hard earth with a hoof tip.

lines.zh: 小个子，你站得太近了。
lines.en: Little one, you are standing far too close.

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味，我闻得到。
lines.en: I can smell the iron on you.

lines.zh: 抬头看我，别眨眼。
lines.en: Look up at me and don't blink.

lines.zh: 你这身骨头，撑不住我一撞。
lines.en: Those bones of yours won't survive one charge.

lines.zh: 我认得你那把剑的寒光。
lines.en: I know the cold gleam of that sword.

lines.zh: 你来恶地做什么，采沙吗？
lines.en: What brings you to the badlands, digging sand?

lines.zh: 你的影子只有我蹄子那么大。
lines.en: Your shadow is barely the size of my hoof.

lines.zh: 我看见你手里攥着的火把。
lines.en: I see the torch clenched in your hand.

lines.zh: 别退，退了我也会追上。
lines.en: Don't back away; I'd catch you anyway.

lines.zh: 你呼吸乱了，我听得很清楚。
lines.en: Your breathing has gone ragged, and I hear it all.

lines.zh: 皮很厚，但我还是疼。
lines.en: My hide is thick, but it still hurts.

lines.zh: 这一下让我哼出声。
lines.en: That one made me grunt out loud.

lines.zh: 我晃了晃脑袋，站稳。
lines.en: I shake my head and plant my feet.

lines.zh: 别以为这点伤能让我停。
lines.en: Don't think that's enough to stop me.

lines.zh: 我背后的旧疤又裂开了。
lines.en: The old scar on my back has split again.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，把重心压低。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and drop my weight.

lines.zh: 疼，就更快地冲上来。
lines.en: It hurts, so I charge even harder.

lines.zh: 血从角根处渗出来。
lines.en: Blood seeps from the base of my horns.

lines.zh: 我退半步，马上又顶回来。
lines.en: I step back once, then shove right back in.

lines.zh: 我把自己当成一堵墙，墙也会裂。
lines.en: I make myself a wall, and walls crack too.

lines.zh: 金苹果派？我一口能吞一整块。
lines.en: Golden apple pie? I could swallow a whole one.

lines.zh: 你把肉举高点，我够得着。
lines.en: Hold the meat higher; I can reach it.

lines.zh: 这点食物，还不够我塞牙。
lines.en: That's not enough to fill a gap in my teeth.

lines.zh: 我闻到烤过的甜味了。
lines.en: I smell something baked and sweet.

lines.zh: 放下就走，别拿在手里晃。
lines.en: Set it down and leave; stop waving it about.

lines.zh: 吃的归我，你也归我。
lines.en: The food is mine, and so are you.

lines.zh: 我低头凑近，鼻息喷在你手上。
lines.en: I lean down and breathe warm air onto your hand.

lines.zh: 你想用吃的换一条命？
lines.en: You think a snack buys back your life?

lines.zh: 我咬住篮子的边，连你都拖过来。
lines.en: I bite the basket's rim and drag you along with it.

lines.zh: 香味让我放慢了脚步。
lines.en: The smell slows my stride.

lines.zh: 我撞上去，你退了三步。
lines.en: I bump you, and you stagger back three steps.

lines.zh: 别贴着我的肋侧走。
lines.en: Don't walk against my ribs like that.

lines.zh: 肩膀碰肩膀，你像撞上石墙。
lines.en: Shoulder to shoulder, you may as well hit a wall.

lines.zh: 地上的碎石被我踢到你脚边。
lines.en: Loose stones scatter from my feet to yours.

lines.zh: 我侧身一挤，你就让开了。
lines.en: I lean my bulk in, and you give way.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的蹄子，我哼了一声。
lines.en: You step on my hoof and I grunt.

lines.zh: 我的角擦过你的护甲。
lines.en: My horn scrapes across your armor.

lines.zh: 两个人宽的通道，我一个占满。
lines.en: A two-man corridor, and I fill all of it.

lines.zh: 我被你顶得偏了一下头。
lines.en: Your shove tips my head to one side.

lines.zh: 站稳，牛角不长眼睛。
lines.en: Steady yourself; my horns have no eyes.

lines.zh: 我们不必成对，只并肩守着这片荒原。
lines.en: We don't need a pair; we just guard the waste together.

lines.zh: 牛角对碰，就是我们的招呼。
lines.en: Horns knocking horns is how we greet.

lines.zh: 同类相见，先比谁的肩膀更宽。
lines.en: When kin meet, we compare shoulders first.

lines.zh: 我低吼一声，你在远处回应。
lines.en: I growl low, and you answer from far off.

lines.zh: 我们并排走，尘土合成一片。
lines.en: We walk abreast and our dust merges into one.

lines.zh: 这荒原够大，能容下两个头颅。
lines.en: This waste is wide enough for two heads.

lines.zh: 蹄声成双，地也跟着抖。
lines.en: Two sets of hooves, and the ground shakes along.

lines.zh: 我把最好的那块地让给它。
lines.en: I give it the best patch of ground.

lines.zh: 两头牛挤在一起，谁都不肯让。
lines.en: Two bulls pressed together, neither giving way.

lines.zh: 我们一起抬头，看同一轮月。
lines.en: We lift our heads and watch the same moon.

lines.zh: 一块绿宝石碎片，归我的收藏。
lines.en: An emerald shard joins my collection.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡起那颗钻石碎片。
lines.en: I bend and scoop up the diamond shard.

lines.zh: 地上的金苹果派，是我的战利品。
lines.en: That golden apple pie on the ground is my prize.

lines.zh: 我拾起宝盒，夹在腋下。
lines.en: I pick up the chest and tuck it under my arm.

lines.zh: 那枚急速指环，滚到我脚边。
lines.en: That swiftness ring rolled right to my hoof.

lines.zh: 我一把抓起掉落的皮革。
lines.en: I snatch up the dropped hides in one grab.

lines.zh: 小东西落地的声音，我从不放过。
lines.en: I never miss the sound of something small hitting dirt.

lines.zh: 我把捡到的东西都塞进腰带。
lines.en: I stuff everything I find into my belt.

lines.zh: 你掉的剑，我也照样收走。
lines.en: The sword you dropped comes with me too.

lines.zh: 我蹲下，把铁块捏进掌心。
lines.en: I crouch and close my fist around the iron.

lines.zh: 你走进我的视野，正中我意。
lines.en: You walk into my sight, exactly as I wanted.

lines.zh: 我压低牛角，对准你的胸口。
lines.en: I lower my horns and aim them at your chest.

lines.zh: 呼吸停了半拍，那是出手的前兆。
lines.en: My breath stops half a beat; that's the sign.

lines.zh: 你的味道从我左前方飘来。
lines.en: Your scent drifts in from my front left.

lines.zh: 我锁定你了，别指望跑。
lines.en: I have you now; don't plan on running.

lines.zh: 眼睛一沉，地就先震了一下。
lines.en: My eyes narrow, and the ground shakes first.

lines.zh: 我踏出第一步时，你已经晚了。
lines.en: By my first step, you are already too late.

lines.zh: 距离够了，我不用再等。
lines.en: Close enough; no more waiting.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声，把位置送给了我。
lines.en: Your footsteps handed me your position.

lines.zh: 我鼻翼一掀，认准了你。
lines.en: My nostrils flare and I fix on you.

lines.zh: 这下，荒原上只剩你我。
lines.en: Now there's only you and me on this waste.

lines.zh: 我转动脖子，关节咔的一响。
lines.en: I roll my neck, and the joint cracks.

lines.zh: 我一步不落地跟着你的影子。
lines.en: I follow your shadow without missing a step.

lines.zh: 你往哪边躲，我的角就对准哪。
lines.en: Wherever you dodge, my horns aim there.

lines.zh: 你跑得再急，也跑不过我的耐性。
lines.en: Run as you like; you can't outlast my patience.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚踝，那是最先垮的地方。
lines.en: I watch your ankles; they fail first.

lines.zh: 每一次呼吸，都在量你的距离。
lines.en: Every breath measures the distance to you.

lines.zh: 我把牛角对准你退路的方向。
lines.en: I angle my horns toward your line of retreat.

lines.zh: 你爬上坡，我在坡下等着。
lines.en: You climb the slope; I wait at the bottom.

lines.zh: 我留意你手里那支箭。
lines.en: I keep an eye on the arrow in your hand.

lines.zh: 你换手了，我也换了个角度。
lines.en: You switch hands, and I change my angle.

lines.zh: 我慢慢绕，把你逼向岩石。
lines.en: I circle slowly, herding you toward the rocks.

lines.zh: 尘土里，我的眼睛一直没眨。
lines.en: Through the dust, my eyes never blink.

lines.zh: 你喘得越来越重，我听得很清。
lines.en: Your breathing grows heavier; I hear every gasp.

lines.zh: 牛角捅进你的护甲，一阵钝响。
lines.en: My horns punch your armor with a dull crack.

lines.zh: 我一撞，你连镐都握不稳。
lines.en: One charge, and you can't even hold your pick.

lines.zh: 我的重拳砸下，你的手臂发麻。
lines.en: My fist comes down and your arm goes numb.

lines.zh: 挨了我这一下，你挖不动也跑不快。
lines.en: After that blow you can hardly dig, let alone run.

lines.zh: 蹄子踏下，你被钉在原地。
lines.en: My hoof stamps down and pins you where you stand.

lines.zh: 我抬手一扫，你就滑出两步。
lines.en: I sweep an arm and you slide back two steps.

lines.zh: 这一下，你的膝盖沉了下去。
lines.en: That one sends your knees down.

lines.zh: 我把你顶飞，撞在身后的石头上。
lines.en: I hurl you into the stone behind you.

lines.zh: 你身上多了道角痕。
lines.en: You're carrying a new horn mark now.

lines.zh: 打完这拳，我连气都不喘。
lines.en: After that punch I'm not even short of breath.

lines.zh: 我从恶地的裂土里直起身。
lines.en: I rise out of the cracked badlands earth.

lines.zh: 麦田边的影子忽然有了角。
lines.en: The shadow by the wheatfield suddenly grows horns.

lines.zh: 我在这里出现，风都停了。
lines.en: I appear here, and even the wind stops.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子刚落地，草就伏了。
lines.en: My hooves touch down and the grass bows.

lines.zh: 荒原多了个会走路的石堆。
lines.en: The waste gains a walking pile of stone.

lines.zh: 我睁眼时，第一件事是找出口。
lines.en: When my eyes open, I look for a way out first.

lines.zh: 沙尘散开，我站在其中。
lines.en: The dust clears, and there I stand.

lines.zh: 我来了，带着一身的铁味。
lines.en: I've arrived, stinking of iron.

lines.zh: 这片平原，从今天起有我。
lines.en: This plain has me in it from today on.

lines.zh: 我把角从土里拔出来。
lines.en: I pull my horns free of the soil.

lines.zh: 火舌舔过我的腿，只烤热了皮毛。
lines.en: Flames lick my legs and only warm my hide.

lines.zh: 我从高处落地，脚底一点没软。
lines.en: I hit the ground from height and my legs don't buckle.

lines.zh: 水灌进鼻子，我硬撑着浮上来。
lines.en: Water floods my nose and I force myself up.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，耳鸣得厉害。
lines.en: The blast flips me over and my ears ring.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在肩头，我随手拔掉。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder; I pluck it out.

lines.zh: 咒光钻进骨头里，闷闷地烧。
lines.en: Spell-light works into my bones, smoldering.

lines.zh: 空着肚子，我的力气一点点漏。
lines.en: Empty-bellied, my strength leaks away.

lines.zh: 雷劈在角上，我浑身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my horns and my whole body numbs.

lines.zh: 虚空的黑吞住我，我竟没处使力。
lines.en: The void swallows me and there's nothing to push against.
